about.title: 關於Serene
about.description: 我們致力於透過真實的連結來激發快樂！我們的使命是創造一個充滿活力和包容的空間，讓人們在美味的餐點中享受歡笑、誠實和難忘的友誼。加入我們，享受有趣、真摯的對話和一點魔法！
about.subSlogan: 友誼需面對面交流，才能真正萌芽！

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.description: We felt a void—a lack of opportunity to socialize and connect with others. Inspired by this need, we envisioned an app called Serene, designed to help people forge new friendships over shared meals and fine wine. By incorporating a personality test, Serene aims to match like-minded individuals, fostering genuine connections that inspire and uplift. The goal is to create a vibrant community where people can grow together, share experiences, and influence one another positively. Through Serene, we hope to transform dining into a meaningful social experience for everyone.

ourMission.title: Our Mission
ourMission.description: At Serene, our mission is to build a vibrant community where like-minded individuals can connect over good food and fine wine. We believe that meaningful relationships are essential to a fulfilling life, yet often feel like a desert in today’s fast-paced world. Whether you’re seeking friendship, networking opportunities, or even romance, Serene provides the perfect setting to meet new people. By fostering genuine connections in a relaxed atmosphere, we aim to transform dining into a delightful experience that enriches lives. Join us in creating a space where friendships blossom and opportunities abound, making every meal a chance for connection.

brief.title: Toast to New Friendships!
brief.paragraph1: Serene hosts refined dinners with a tasting menu, encouraging guests to forge new friendships through exquisite cuisine, fine wine, and engaging conversations.
brief.paragraph2: Serene collaborates with top restaurants to offer exclusive tasting menus tailored for our guests. Each dish is thoughtfully paired with handpicked wines, ensuring an unforgettable evening filled with exceptional flavors and delightful experiences.

partners.paragraph: Serene ensures the finest experience by partnering directly with restaurants, bars, and wine distributors. We anticipate you meeting your new best friend in the most enjoyable and elegant setting.

dining.description: Serene has partnered with the best restaurants for an unforgettable group dining experience! Savor a uniquely crafted set menu featuring both beloved favorites and hidden gems. Join the fun!

drinks.description: Serene enhances your dining with an exquisite wine selection! Enjoy curated pairings at dinner, and effortlessly purchase your favorites to take home or gift. Cheers to unforgettable flavors!

wellness.description: Serene knows personal wellness transforms busy lives! Enjoy rejuvenating massages, spa treatments, and relaxing activities that support your journey to well-being—your gateway to endless possibilities awaits!

events.description: Serene hosts exciting events for members to connect and have fun! Enjoy delightful dinners, lively happy hours, cozy book clubs, exclusive screenings, and more—endless possibilities await your next adventure!

fitness.description: Serene keeps your energy high and spirit adventurous! Enjoy fun Pilates, exhilarating HIIT, and dynamic gym workouts while sweating it out with friends. Let’s get moving together on this fitness journey!

mentoring.description: Serene is a vibrant community of dynamic professionals! Connect for networking, career coaching, and mentoring. With talents from various fields, we create endless possibilities and make a positive impact together!
